name: Memory write
summary: Store a named text note in this run’s durable SQLite memory.
description: Store a named text note in this run’s durable SQLite memory. Memory is agent-owned state at .memory.sqlite in the workspace. NOTES.md is the convention for free-form working notes; it is not created automatically. Memory contains no permissions or supervisor state. Read operations return an empty list before the first write.
limitations: Values are text, at most 20000 characters; keys are at most 128 characters.
Listing/search return at most 100 entries, ordered by key; no embeddings.
Search case folding uses SQLite lower (ASCII); the substring is literal, not a SQL pattern.
The agent may overwrite its own database with workspace tools; corruption is an error.

failure_modes.condition: Database is corrupt, locked or inaccessible.
failure_modes.recovery: Use working notes in NOTES.md; memory may need restoring from a checkpoint.
